A series of hierarchical factions acted as the '''government''' of the [[Bosph (species)|Bosph]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Bosph/Legends|Bosph]]. Each member of the government was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and a member of one of the factions, each of which had specific functions within the society.
